class.name: OcgGraphic3dCubemap
class.brief_description: Base class for cubemaps. It is iterator over cubemap sides.
class.description: ! Base class for cubemaps. ! It is iterator over cubemap sides.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructor defining direct cubemap initialization from PixMap.

method.name: More
method.description: Returns whether the iterator has reached the end (true if it hasn't).

method.name: Next
method.description: Moves iterator to the next cubemap side. Uses OpenGL cubemap sides order +X -> -X -> +Y -> -Y -> +Z -> -Z.

method.name: ZIsInverted
method.description: Returns whether Z axis is inverted.

method.name: HasMipmaps
method.description: Returns whether mipmaps of cubemap will be generated or not.

method.name: SetMipmapsGeneration
method.description: Sets whether to generate mipmaps of cubemap or not.
